items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I got that listening at Orvin Frazola. Yeah, listening at him.

ctx.x: They say Buddy Petit could do a lot of that stuff. Was he like that?

Yeah, Buddy Petit too. Yeah, he was. Yeah, he was like that. Well, Kid René, Kid René could variate a lot too. I'll tell you, they were real good musicians. Those street boys, you know, that I can remember now, they were street. They were really good. They knew what they were doing and they would do it. They'd look like they'd do it better and better each time they would come out. They'd play better and better. I tell you, they really was a wonderful group to play with. And I enjoyed playing with them because it…
One time I wanted to ask you, brother, it was, well first I wanted to ask you, how long have you had your nickname Brother Cullenbrack?
